security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Local desktop explorer for Parquet, CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines, Excel and SQLite
bundle.longDescription: Sivro explores local Parquet, CSV, TSV, JSON, JSON Lines, Excel (xlsx, xlsm, xlsb, xls) and SQLite files with parsing previews, worksheet and table selection, exact-number JSON document inspection, schema inspection, a paged grid, filtering, sorting, column profiles, and Parquet, CSV, TSV, JSON array and JSON Lines exports.
